case_name: Ermita Bar Assault – Elias vs David

canonical_solution.motive: Alcohol-fueled confrontation, escalated to physical assault
canonical_solution.method: Struck victim David Garcia on the head with a glass bottle
key_connections: CCTV clip shows Elias raising bottle and striking victim
Wound photos consistent with glass shard penetration
Latent fingerprint on bottle fragment matches Elias
Victim blood swab consistent with wound location

critical.name: Victim Wound Photos
critical.why_critical: Demonstrates physical injury pattern consistent with glass

dna_collection.requirement: Collected under consent, stored in tamper-evident container
dna_collection.violation_impact: Sample may be excluded or questioned

cctv_recovery.correct_method: Recover via DVR export or certified forensic tool
cctv_recovery.violation_impact: Authenticity of footage may be challenged

RPC_263.penalty: Prision mayor depending on medical findings

prosecution_requirements: Show victim sustained serious physical injury
Link injury to assault act by Elias
Authenticate CCTV footage and forensic recovery
Correlate wound photos with bottle fragments
Fingerprint places weapon in Elias’s possession

perpetrator_identification.check: Did player identify Elias as attacker?

evidence_correlation.check: Did player connect CCTV, wounds, fragments, fingerprints?

method_explanation.check: Did player explain how bottle caused injury?

missing_evidence.critical_missing: CRITICAL ERROR: Missing {evidence_name}. Cannot establish assault without it.

procedural_violations.no_hash: CCTV footage without hash — authenticity challenge likely.
procedural_violations.chain_broken: Incomplete chain of custody weakens admissibility.
procedural_violations.improper_collection: Evidence improperly collected (e.g., bottle fragments not sealed).

legal_issues.no_causation: If wounds cannot be tied to bottle, causation fails.
legal_issues.no_authentication: Footage not authenticated → defense can move to suppress.

strength_assessment.strong: Case solid: CCTV, wounds, weapon fragments, and prints all align.
strength_assessment.weak: Case has major flaws: {flaws}. Likely dismissal.

score_90_plus.example: Excellent. Evidence aligns with law and procedure.

score_70_89.detail: Good foundation, note some missing items
score_70_89.example: Strong case but lacking corroboration on {evidence}.

score_50_69.example: Evidence chain gaps and weak witness support reduce strength.

score_below_50.example: Case cannot be prosecuted. Missing core evidence.
